label: RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3: receipt as standing reception with a real relation to the principle of being
term: receives esse at a moment, as a real relation to the principle of being (Lean `relationalReceipt`)
definition: relationalReceipt h O E: z receives x's esse at t in history v iff x's esse is received in z (E x z, DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN), x is present at t (h.IsAt v x t), and x bears at t the origin relation (definition 7b28be97) to something (O.RelatedAt v x g t for some g). It is standing receipt (RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2, definition 181bb18f) with the relation added, so it carries content beyond reception plus presence: a term to which the receiver is really related as to the principle of its being. A defined interpretation of the primitive present-tense receipt (definition 506ea036), not a further primitive. On this sense the present-tense reading of reception is equivalent to accompaniment (the relation is borne whenever a received-esse thing is present; result relationalPresentIsAccompaniment), and, given accompaniment, correlativity of receiving and giving is equivalent to weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 (result relationalReadingIsTheCrux).
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred, after ST I q.45 a.3 co. and ad 3 (passage fb7bd7bb, read): passive creation is in the creature only a relation to the Creator as principle of its being, and the creature is the subject of that relation. Distinguished from RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 (passion), which requires a giver at the moment, and from RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 (standing composition), which has no term. It takes no side on whether the term gives at the moment; that is the open premise TermGives. q.45 a.3 ad 3 also says that a creature need not be said to be created as long as it exists, because creation imports the relation 'cum quadam novitate seu incoeptione'. That denies the name after onset, not the relation, and plausibly implies (by implicature, not statement) that the relation remains without the novelty; this sense reads the relation without a novelty condition. Would be sourced by a passage that states the creature's relation to the principle of its being, without novelty, as obtaining at each moment of its existence.
